name_reason: Compliant data_fd2_<domain=audio>_<descriptor> name; 'walk_step_sfx_cadence_counter' accurately describes a per-step footstep-SFX cadence counter and 'counter' reflects the scalar type. No Ghidra address residue. The enclosing function fd2_tick_tutorial_progress_with_sfx carries a tutorial-progress misnomer, but the global itself is already correctly named for its true (audio cadence) role.
purpose: Free-running per-step footstep-SFX cadence counter; the sole mutable state of fd2_tick_tutorial_progress_with_sfx, gating footstep SFX via (counter % divisor).
logic_summary: Each walk-step frame, fd2_tick_tutorial_progress_with_sfx selects a divisor (4/6/9) per the walking unit's job cadence class (or 6 when status-immune), plays a footstep SFX if (counter % divisor)==0, then increments the counter. The single C modulo lowers in the binary to four byte reads (one per branch: 0x2ca1a/0x2ca65/0x2ca8c/0x2ca9d) plus one INC at 0x2cacb. No external reader.
element_semantics: Scalar unsigned byte; monotonically incremented once per walk-step frame and used modulo a per-job divisor to phase-gate the footstep SFX. Wraps at 256 (matches binary; cadence is phase-relative so wrap is harmless).
